rationale: The round-5 delta at reviewed commit 0f7f2216 addresses the two prior hard-blocking hook defects without introducing a spec-branch-corrupting defect. ReadState now maps both derivation failure and the healthy multi-active-spec empty-phase ambiguity to ModeIndeterminate, consistent with the instruct honesty predicate. runPreCommit now explicitly blocks ModeIndeterminate on spec/* branches before the former implement-only fallthrough, while retaining the documented escape hatch. All four requested spot checks passed, and the bead worktree remained clean and byte-identical at the reviewed commit.

findings.title: Multi-active-spec ambiguity is represented and blocked
findings.detail: TestReadState_MultipleActiveSpecs_ReturnsNonNilIndeterminate and TestPreCommit_MultipleActiveSpecs_BlocksOnProtectedBranch both passed. The production predicate ctx.DerivationFailed || ctx.Phase == "" prevents initialized ambiguous state from collapsing to nil and the real pre-commit path blocks it on a protected branch.

findings.title: Indeterminate spec branches fail closed across session variants
findings.detail: The no_session and claimed_bead_session variants of TestPreCommit_SpecBranch_IndeterminateFailsClosed both passed, including their healthy-implement and discovery-failure Run() paths. An indeterminate mode can no longer fall through to Pass on spec/* branches.

findings.title: Reviewed worktree stayed byte-identical
findings.detail: After testing, HEAD remained 0f7f2216ba36abe35604e35be63fc57448e75e47; porcelain status was empty and both staged and unstaged diffs were empty. No probe clone was created.
